d: Mali is stepping up its defence ambitions, seeking advanced military technology and stronger partnerships to tackle terrorism across the Sahel. The second edition of the BAMEX Defence Exhibition in Bamako showcases drones, advanced weapons, AI and robotics, with over 1,500 products on display and delegations from more than 40 countries expected. Turkish drone maker Skydagger has showcased its RTF 10-inch FPV, Toyca 05 and Hunter systems, highlighting growing Mali-Turkey defence cooperation and technology transfer.
